data.body: R3 dry-run enumeration (2026-08-15, grep sweep of all sanctioned-primitive callers): (1) reconcile_helpers.py:226/246 git_adapter.add+commit — covered by blocker gnatty-comparable-ynambu. (2) bridge-state projects_store + alert_store._atomic_write — covered by blocker cubiform-wooden-fruitbat. (3) ONE additional site NOT covered by either blocker: rebar_reconciler/__main__.py:315-355 legacy .reconciler-* lock-file purge — composes read_tree/rm_cached/write_tree/commit_tree/update_ref in a DETACHED temp index with a CAS ref-advance. Concurrency-safe by construction (never touches worktree/index; CAS makes concurrent writers safe), so it needs NO pre-gate remediation: disposition at implementation time is either a durable reasoned marker (detached-index CAS migration) or promotion into git_adapter as a named transaction helper — or outright deletion if the legacy-lock migration is complete by then. (4) _commands/{txn,compact_txn,compact_recovery,delete,init}.py run_git_write callers are store-seam transaction internals per policy d37e — they join R3's sanctioned entry set, not remediation. (5) Workflows clean: only 'git worktree add' setup lines; zero raw-git-ok markers in .github/workflows or scripts/*.sh.
